description: Find a prior job in the bound project when you do not have its id. intent is recent, failed, or reusable. The list never includes prompt text. Use after context loss, for failure triage, or to recover a job to cancel. Requires bearer key. No charge. Read-only. Returns: Matching job summaries for the filter. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT.

capability_key.description: Optional capability key to narrow the search.
capability_key.title: Capability Key

intent.description: Optional search scope: recent (default), failed, or reusable.
intent.title: Intent

limit.description: Optional maximum number of matching jobs (1-100, default 10).
limit.title: Limit

project_id.description: Hosted only: bound project id; omit to use the session-bound project.
project_id.title: Project Id

name: hydracept_jobs_find
title: Find a prior job
